other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
Applicant must be a student enrolled in Sanskrit courses at any government or aided non-government college.
Eligible courses include Post Graduate (M.A. Classic), Acharya, Graduate (B.A. Classic), Shastri, Uttar Madhyama, Purva Madhyama, and Prathama.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹54,000.
Academic qualification for Post Graduate: at least 50% marks in degree examination.
Academic qualification for Acharya: at least 50% marks in Shastri or equivalent examination.
Academic qualification for Graduate: at least 50% marks in 10+2 or equivalent examination.
Academic qualification for Shastri: at least 45% marks in Purva Madhyama.
Academic qualification for Uttar Madhyama: at least 45% marks in Prathama or equivalent.
Academic qualification for Purva Madhyama: admission based on merit in the 5th examination.
benefits_summary: Eligible Sanskrit students receive a monthly scholarship of ₹300 for 10 months.
